{{Hatnote|This article is about the location in {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}. For other uses, see [[Spring of Courage (Disambiguation)]].}} {{Infobox Location |image= {{Media |Screenshot BotW= File:BotW Spring of Courage.png |Screenshot TotK= File:TotK Spring of Courage.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |inhab= |items= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= [[Ravio's Hood]] }} |services= |season= |temperature= |counter= [[Wellspring of Courage]] {{Small|([[Depths]])}} |theme= |related= {{List| * [[Dracozu Lake]] * [[Shae Katha Shrine]] * [[Spring of Power]] * [[Spring of Wisdom]] }} |strategy= |zu= }} The {{Term/Store|Spring of Courage||Series, BotW, TotK, AoC}} is a recurring location in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite|'''Spring of Courage'''|Map|BotW}}{{Cite|'''Spring of Courahe'''|Map|TotK}}{{Cite|Zelda. You and the knights will travel to the Spring of Courage. No matter what it takes, you must awaken your power before the Calamity returns.|King Rhoam|AoC}} ==Features and Overview== ==={{BotW|-}}=== The Spring of Courage is an [[Ancient Hylian Ruin]] located at the northernmost part of the [[Zonai Ruins]], which are hidden within the [[Faron Woods]] in the [[Faron Grasslands]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 413}} It is surrounded by a giant [[Dragon]] statue, the mouth of which serves as the entrance to the Spring. A large [[Tree]] grows from the head of this statue. Inside is a large [[Goddess Statue]] known as the [[Spring of Courage Statue]], which is surrounded by a low level of [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. When [[Link]] approaches the Statue, he will be able to exchange [[Spirit Orb]]s for [[Heart Container]]s or [[Stamina Vessel]]s.{{Cite|It appears you have claimed {{Color BotW|Red|four}} {{Color BotW|Blue|Spirit Orbs}}. In exchange for {{Color BotW|Red|four}} {{Color BotW|Blue|Spirit Orbs}}, I will amplify your being. So tell me what it is that you desire.|Spring of Courage Statue|BotW}} The Dragon, [[Farosh]], has served the Spring since ancient times.{{Cite|A spirit of lightning has taken the form of this giant dragon. Making its home in the Faron region, it's said to have served the Spring of Courage since ancient times. An old saying goes, "The dragon ascends to the heavens as the sun begins to set," but nobody has seen this in the current age. The electricity that coats its body makes it dangerous to get near, but Farosh bears no ill will toward people.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 158}} Prior to the second [[Great Calamity]], [[Princess Zelda]] frequented the Spring of Courage in an attempt to unlock her sealing powers.{{Cite|I've prayed at the Spring of Courage and at the Spring of Power, yet neither awoke anything inside me.|Princess Zelda|BotW}}{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 379}} In the [[Pagos Woods]], Link can find [[Kass]] playing his bandoneon along the [[Faron Highroad]].{{Cite|The forest dragon...|Kass|BotW}} When Link approaches him, he offers to play an "[[Ancient Song]],"{{Cite|I know a song about this place. Would you like to hear the ancient verse passed down in this region?|Kass|BotW}} which describes finding an [[Ancient Shrine]] where a forest Dragon can be found.{{Cite|Where the forest {{Color BotW|Blue|dragon}} splays its jaws,
A {{Color BotW|Red|shrine}} sleeps with noble cause.|Kass|BotW}} Listening to this starts "[[The Serpent's Jaws]]" [[Shrine Quest]]. When Link first arrives at the Spring of Courage, [[Hylia]] will speak to him through the Spring of Courage Statue, instructing him to offer [[Farosh's Scale]] to the Spring.{{Cite|... You have done well to find this spring. Offer {{Color BotW|Red|Farosh's scale}}, received from the golden spirit, to the {{Color BotW|Blue|Spring of Courage}}. I, Goddess Hylia, will guide you.|Spring of Courage Statue|BotW}} If he does so, the doorway behind the Statue will open, allowing him access to [[Shae Katha Shrine]].{{Cite|Your path has shown itself. Now go forth.|Spring of Courage Statue|BotW}}{{Cite|Just as the Goddess instructed, you threw {{Color BotW|Red|Farosh's scale}} into the Spring of Courage. A shrine appeared as a result!|Adventure Log|BotW}} During the "[[EX Treasure: Merchant Hood]]" [[Side Quest]], which is exclusive to {{TCB}} [[Downloadable Content]] pack, Link will learn from ''[[Misko's EX Journal 2]]'' that they hid [[Ravio's Hood]] on the right hand of the Dragon statue surrounding the Spring of Courage.{{Cite|The traveling merchant's hood is {{Color BotW|Red|in the right hand of the dragon that consumes the Spring of Courage at Dracozou Lake}}.|Misko's EX Journal 2|BotW}} At this location, Link will find a metallic EX [[Treasure Chest]], inside of which is Ravio's Hood.{{Cite|You found the treasure chest in the right hand of the dragon ruins at Dracozu Lake and obtained {{Color BotW|Red|Ravio's Hood}}!|Adventure Log|BotW}} One additional [[Treasure Chest]] can be found at the Spring of Courage. At the entrance to the Spring, there is a metallic Chest that contains a [[Gold Rupee]]. [[File:BotW Korok Seed Icon.png|left|40px]] In total, two [[Korok Seed Puzzle]]s are located at the Spring of Courage. The first is a [[Cube Pattern]] on the Dragon statue's right hand, which must be solved by matching it to the Pattern on its left hand. The second Puzzle is a [[Rock]] on top of the large Tree, and Link can pick it up to reveal that it is a [[Natural Hiding Spot]]. Once each of these Puzzles have been solved, a [[Korok]] will appear and give him a [[Korok Seed]].{{Cite|Yahaha! You found me!|Korok|BotW}} ====Creatures==== {{Gallery List|Creatures |BotW= Bladed Rhino Beetle, Fairy, Hot-Footed Frog, Restless Cricket, Rugged Rhino Beetle }} ====Enemies==== {{Gallery List|Enemies |BotW= Black Moblin {{Equipment|BotW|Spiked Moblin Club}} }} ====Materials==== {{Gallery List|Materials |BotW= Spicy Pepper }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Trivia== * The Spring of Courage bears a strong resemblance to the [[Skyview Spring]] in {{SS}}. Like the Skyview Spring, the Spring of Courage is located in the [[Faron Woods]], and it bears similarly weathered structures. ==Nomenclature== The Spring of Courage is named after the [[Triforce of Courage]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 351}} {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Spring of Courage NM Promotional Screenshot.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}A promotional image from the Winter 2021 issue of Nintendo Magazine featuring the Spring of Courage File:BotW Spring of Courage Goddess Statue.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Goddess Statue close-up File:BotW Spring of Courage Statue.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Dragon sculpture outside the Spring of Courage File:BotW The Serpent's Jaws.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}The Dragon sculpture File:BotW Spring of Courage Korok.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}One of the Koroks found at the Spring of Courage ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ancient Hylian Ruin * Dracozu Lake * EX Treasure: Merchant Hood * Faron Grasslands * Faron Woods * Shae Katha Shrine * Spring of Courage Statue * Spring of Power * Spring of Wisdom * The Serpent's Jaws * Skyview Spring * Zonai Ruins }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Ancient Hylian Ruins, Faron Grasslands, Springs |locations= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
